question: Does the density-dependent Poisson-binomial grain marginal formalized in the 2026 Stanford EE367 report predict held Kodak 250D diffuse-rms granularity better than both channel constants and the retained characteristic-slope baseline?

primary_source.title: Physically-Based Post-Processing Framework for Emulating Analog Color Photography
primary_source.author: Daiki Nakajima
primary_source.source_boundary: Use only the report's stated stochastic family and equations. Do not import or copy its derivative code or profiles, and do not treat those profiles as independent film measurements.

model.derivation: Poisson thinning gives developed count Poisson(N*p/s), with p=(D-Dmin)/(Dmax-Dmin), s=1-u*p and density increment (Dmax-Dmin)*s/N; therefore variance is A*p*(1-u*p).
model.density_coordinate: P2Q Status-M density normalized independently per channel to [0,1] over its frozen density bounds
model.fit: nonnegative least squares on development variances only
fit_parameters: one nonnegative variance floor per channel

split.eligibility: finite P4AV points inside the same channel's inclusive P2Q exposure domain
split.ordering: ascending log10 exposure independently within each channel
split.development: eligible sorted index modulo 3 is 0 or 2

controls.channel_constant: one development variance mean per channel
controls.no_competition_poisson: same fit with uniformity fixed to zero
controls.characteristic_slope: exact P4AW characteristic_slope_without_p5j confirmation predictions, without refitting

metrics.point_error: absolute natural-log ratio of predicted sigma_d to observed sigma_d
metrics.control_improvement: (control median error - candidate median error) / control median error
metrics.shape_rank: Spearman correlation between predicted and observed sigma_d per channel on confirmation rows

branch_rule.pass: Retain the Poisson-binomial marginal only as a compact generic density-dependent granularity baseline and open a separately frozen stochastic-executor parity test before any image use.
branch_rule.fail: Close this exact uniformity, normalization, split, fit family and gates without tuning. Retain the simpler P4AX amplitude family and move to a new measured or mechanism-distinct observation.

forbidden: copy Stanford or spektrafilm code, profiles, parameters or output pixels
change uniformity, density normalization, split, controls or gates after scoring
interpret fitted amplitude as microscopic grain count or particle area
claim stock calibration, particular-roll/process/scanner truth, photographic quality or product readiness
claim_ceiling: Held-exposure compatibility of one 2026 paper-derived Poisson-binomial density marginal with first-party Kodak 250D typical granularity curves; not spatial NPS, microscopic structure, roll/process/scanner calibration, stock response or product evidence.
